noncomputable def VTask.greatestOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ b) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ ub } :=
let ⟨ub, Hinh⟩ := Hinh in
let rec findGreatest ub' h := match Hb ub' h with
| true => ub'
| false => findGreatest (ub' - 1) (fun z h => h)
in
{ val := findGreatest b (fun _ _ => trivial),
  property := by
    intro z hz
    apply Hb
    apply findGreatest
    intros z' hz'
    apply hz'
}
